ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a blue shaded polygon, with the bottom side divided into two segments, the left segment labeled 16 and the right segment labeled 28. A pink dashed line extends vertically downward from the highest vertex to the bottom side, and this vertical height consists of 15 above and 20 below, so the total height is 15+20=35. There is a vertical side on the right, whose height is the same as the 20 below the dashed line. The pink dashed line also extends horizontally from the position of height 20 to the right, showing that the height of the right vertical side is 20. Reasoning: Divide the figure into two parts by the dashed vertical line. The left side is a right triangle, with base 16 and height 35, and its area is (1/2)×16×35=280. The right side is a trapezoid, with the two parallel vertical sides being 35 and 20 respectively, and the horizontal distance between them is 28, so its area is ((35+20)/2)×28=770. The total area is 280+770=1050.

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: place the polygon on coordinate axes using the visible lengths. Let the bottom-left vertex be (0,0), the foot of the dashed vertical be (16,0), the top vertex be (16,35) because 20+15=35, the bottom-right vertex be (44,0) because 16+28=44, and the upper-right vertex be (44,20). Then apply the shoelace formula to the polygon with vertices (0,0), (16,35), (44,20), (44,0). The shoelace area is 1050.
method.CoT_raw:
Image description: The attached diagram shows a blue quadrilateral. The bottom edge is divided into lengths 16 and 28. A dashed vertical line rises from the division point; its lower part is labeled 20 and its upper part is labeled 15, so the full height to the top vertex is 20 + 15 = 35. A dashed horizontal line at height 20 reaches the right vertical side, so the upper-right vertex is 20 units above the base.

Reasoning: Place the bottom-left vertex at (0,0). The dashed vertical foot is at (16,0). The top vertex is at (16,35). The bottom-right vertex is at (16+28,0) = (44,0). The upper-right vertex is at (44,20). Use the polygon vertices in order: (0,0), (16,35), (44,20), (44,0). By the shoelace formula, area = |(0·35 + 16·20 + 44·0 + 44·0) - (0·16 + 35·44 + 20·44 + 0·0)| / 2 = |320 - 2420| / 2 = 1050.
